palette: docs/palette.json (all stamps palette-locked, 0 off-palette, binary alpha)
how_to_use: Paste stamps as whole cels at integer offsets (never scale or rotate). All head stamps share one canvas origin: row 0 = top of the bow, col 12.5 = head centre; the skull dome spans rows ~10-22 in every direction, chin/nape is the last row (N is 4 rows shorter: no chin). Place a head with its centre on the guide's head joint and keep it byte-identical in every frame of a direction except deliberate squash/expression frames (offset the bow cel 1 px for lag). Rim light is NOT baked in: add the camera-locked pink_0 rim on the full silhouette afterwards (<= 60 % of contour, broken). Sheen hair_2 = upper-left (key light top-left) in every direction.

head_N.note: back, bow loops rise above bun, nape bottom (no chin; 4 rows shorter: align skull_top)

bow_S.use: bow+bun-top cel cut from head_S; for secondary-motion frames (bow lag/settle) offset this cel 1 px against the head

bow_SE.use: bow+bun-top cel cut from head_SE; for secondary-motion frames (bow lag/settle) offset this cel 1 px against the head

bow_E.use: bow+bun-top cel cut from head_E; for secondary-motion frames (bow lag/settle) offset this cel 1 px against the head

bow_N.use: bow+bun-top cel cut from head_N; for secondary-motion frames (bow lag/settle) offset this cel 1 px against the head

katana_down.use: blade straight down; mirror horizontally for the hook on the other side

katana_idle_2to1.use: idle angle (blade down-right 2:1, ~27 deg); mirror for down-left. Blade 2 px, hook >= 3 px with a gap.
